tagline: Vitamin C Moisturizer – Bright & Strengthen Your Skin Barrier
intro: Reveal naturally radiant and healthy-looking skin with our Vitamin C Moisturizer, a lightweight yet deeply nourishing formula designed to brighten, hydrate, and protect your skin every day. Powered with the goodness of Vitamin C, this moisturizer helps improve skin tone, reduce dark spots, and strengthen the skin barrier for a smoother, glowing complexion.

Enriched with Orange Peel Extract and Fermented Carrot Extract, it delivers antioxidant protection while boosting skin hydration and repair. Its non-greasy texture absorbs quickly, making it perfect for daily use on all skin types.

li: Helps reduce dark spots and dullness
Strengthens and repairs the skin barrier

p: Apply a small amount to clean face and neck. Gently massage until fully absorbed. Use morning and night for best results.
